reason: ImageGen honoured heading but drifted scale/placement of the capital group (Onslaught painted about 1.5x the guide; upper Dominator about 13 frame px high). No regeneration: each of the three painted hulls was cut out by its alpha component and fitted onto its guide hull with one uniform scale and a translation (alpha centroid to guide centroid). No pixels were repainted.
method: result resized 1672x940 -> 1728x972 (guide size, Lanczos); per-hull uniform scale = mean of guide/result bbox width and height ratios; Lanczos resample
